html:
The east side of Phu Quoc Island offers a calm and authentic experience, away from crowded tourist areas. This region is famous for its sunrise views, traditional fishing villages, local farms, and peaceful rural roads.

With Vietlook Travel’s one day private car service, you can explore the east of the island comfortably, at your own pace, and fully customize your itinerary.

Centre Hotel Area to East Island Distance and Travel Time

The distance from Phu Quoc Centre Hotel Area to East Island attractions is approximately fifteen to thirty kilometers, depending on the selected destinations.

Travel time is usually around thirty to sixty minutes one way, excluding sightseeing and photo stops.

Suggested East Island Attractions

During your one day private car tour, you may visit:

  • Ham Ninh fishing village

  • Ham Ninh pier and local seafood market

  • Pearl farms

  • Pepper gardens

  • Local countryside and sunrise viewpoints

This tour is ideal for travelers who enjoy local culture, quiet scenery, and short travel distances.

Flexible One Day Private Car Service

  • Pick up and drop off at Centre Hotel Area

  • Flexible departure time

  • Custom itinerary based on your interests

  • Private vehicle only for your group

  • No fixed schedule or rushed stops

You decide where to go and how long to stay.

Professional Driver and Comfortable Vehicles

  • Experienced local drivers

  • Clean and air conditioned cars

  • Safe and smooth driving

  • Baby seat available upon request

Available vehicle options include five seat cars, seven seat cars, sixteen seat minibuses, and Carnival luxury vehicles.
